notes.title: Version 1.0 is being released on July 31st!
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 is being released on July 31st!

The Final frontier is here. Thank you for supporting BatleGroupVR during these 3 years!

Drama of the distant galaxy

Decky from our community will do a live broadcast on BGVR Steam page this Sunday. Rumor is — there will be a real time performance of intergalactic battle spiced up with community lore. If there will be enough people in the chat box, we will do a giveaway of Star Survivor — a small action roguelike game in space.

notes.title: January Update Summary
notes.notes:
Jan 2021 - Update Summary
Hope everyone's new year is starting off well! I've made a bunch of little changes via several mini patches since the end of December. Here's the full list of updates from 12/27/2020 to 1/21/2021.

Changes / New Features
- changed weapon arc indicators on the map view to change color depending on if the weapon is out of range (grey), firing (yellow), or flash red if min range
- added a new capital weapon to the battleship (it didn't have a special before), called the Burst Cannon, which will fire a volley of high damage projectiles at ALL targets 90 degrees left and right of the battleship.
- fixed conquest report warp lane upgrade always level 1
- right-hand menu Clear View now works on all bridge sizes
- changed warp out a method to attempt to fix objects intersecting with the bridge (unverified) 
- shipyard ship descriptions now show slot details on tooltip hover
- ship roster now shows equipped components on tooltip hover
- conquest fleets now revert to their previous location if leave/defeat during the battle
- adjusted heavy transport resupply component to not overlap with other modules

Save File Backup System
I added a backup save feature that will save your fleet data at the beginning and end of your session to /backups in your game save directory. Save will be performed on start game and game exit, they can be found here: C:\Users\yourname\AppData\LocalLow\SpaceOwl Games\BattleGroupVR\backups
Files that start with "gsd-XXXX" are fleet/campaign files, ppd.gd is the player unlock progress.

You can restore them by copying to the root folder (C:\Users\yourname\AppData\LocalLow\SpaceOwl Games\BattleGroupVR) and removing the timestamp after the dash, so your backup file will be like gsd1234.gd and your backup will be gsd1234-4398523453.gd, so just remove the "-4398523453" in the file name / override your old save and your restored.

Bug Fixes
- fixed buying issues for conquest and MP when no campaign has been started
- fixed selling ships in Multiplayer issue
- fixed upgrade chip not being able to be picked up in the tutorial
- fixed conquest name + portrait change do not save
- fixed loophole where flagship can be set to docked ship
- fixed issue with multiplayer fleets not recalculated consistently
- fixed issue with selling unlimited components
- fixed issue with copy leader not sending a command to all units
- fixed helm speed bar stuck at 100%
- fixed component description display issues not updating
- fixed conquest new accounts stuck in select faction menu

Mission Update
This weekend was all missions. Finished gathering the majority of the story voice acting audio so it was getting them implemented and fine-tuning the later missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/912218802fa6f080cf990f295d56ad6fa7dccd8e.jpg

Adjustments:
- capture station now has a delay before the enemy begins to charge, difficulty level reduces delay
- rescue mission now has a delay before the enemy begins to charge, difficulty level reduces delay

The Dreadnought
New ship to unlock on the final mission and the flagship of the big bad. Measuring in at 1700 meters, over 24 hardpoints, and a dedicated bomber launch bay, we have The Dreadnought.

Going to be working on some feature requests such as being able to stow away ships you don't want to bring to battle but do not want to sell. Also playing around with stealth ship ideas:

notes.title: Weekend Update Summary 8/21/2020
notes.notes:
Small Update Summary For The Week 8/21/20

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/45beaf2ccf0c79b5e7a8148be2739b3e936b4e6c.jpg

New build out! Here's the change list:
- equipment information can be viewed before purchase
- added microphone visual feedback for voice command
- added windows speech compatibility check-in options for voice command
- added more steam assets and workshop reliability, still WIP
- added tooltips to hand menu tabs
- ships now turn to warp out the direction at their normal rate instead of the sometimes quick lerp to the rotation
- added unity analytics to track how people progress should help identify and smooth out the difficulty curve
- replaced the dreadnought with the new MK2 now with even more guns, if you own a dreadnought your setup may be weird (equipment in the wrong places) so you may need to unequip/reconfigure your ship
- reduced ship ramming damage tick from 0.25 sec to 0.5, this should half the damage over time taken so more opportunity to save a ship being rammed

Bug Fixes:
- added additional value clamping to the map momentum to better control the "fly away" map issues
- fixed getting stuck in time slow if warp was started, it now exits you from timewarp before the jump
- fixed self-selecting your own ship from the helm
- fixed slider bar cap for speed and subsystem power going beyond the slider
- fixed medium laser turrets not firing
- fixed mission space stations material or model missing
- fixed issue with new ship unlocks causing the menu to not show continue button after score screen
- changed warp out the rotation to avoid zero error crashes on certain processors

Other:
- consolidated ship visual assets to make way for easy switching of ship skins, the ships come in black, blue, green, grey, red, white, yellow.

Improvements:
- add a lot of local coop stability improvements, coop mode will stay active in between missions, added a new keyboard diagram for PC commands
- restricted skirmish map light source/sun from appearing below the "horizon" causing everything looks black
- new ship HUD display for warping out that shows alignment as the ship orients for warp.

What's next?
Currently working on getting the Steam Workshop Browser fleshed out, right now it only barely functions, and so trying to get that more stable but there's already more then 10 ships on the Workshop so that's excited! Also finishing up the main missions, right now the later missions are very work in progress.

notes.title: Lazy Captain's Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/bc24bbbeb1fdea1a369795c2d76be6b37b3f21fc.jpg

First off I wanted to say: THANK YOU! - This past week has been an amazing experience and I just wanted to thank everyone for their support and feedback. The Early Access has gone very well, with very positive reviews so far. I am so glad that everyone is enjoying the game! It really means a lot!

Updates
Ok, onto the updates! This week was focused on bug fixes and quality of life changes. The major issues were that sometimes the menu's being out of reach or awkwardly high or low or even behind you.

New changes:

 added hover scan to the buttons, so you can now just "mouse over" them to trigger
 this also works with sliders so you can adjust speed/power in helm at a distance
 grip for adjustment menu bars also works with this so just hover over and grip/trigger to move them around
 added z-depth to auto-adjusting menus so they will get closer to you if far away in addition to the height adjustment
 added menu distance safety check where the menu will reset to default if more then 6ft away as they are immune to social distancing
 auto-adjusting menus is now an option in the settings


So now you can all relax and sit down and interact with everything without having to even touch it! It's actually very convenient, especially if you want to play seated and don't want to adjust every menu perfectly. 

Bug Fixes:

 WMR controller bindings fixed
 Cosmo controller bindings fixed
 Mission 8 briefing fixed


Currently Working On:
Custom ship modding to allow an easier and flexible way to create custom ships. Decided on the Unity Asset Bundle method. Also working with Steam Workshops so these can be posted and imported by anyone within the game. Seeing good results so far!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/fb37166b2e345d39f6bbde6cde379864751e7184.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/43ee30f99a988cd0a82a4593900ae53bbba9ad5a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145337/971f967e2d70a8e462da9bf734599d39ba07f185.png

If you're interested in the mods, latest news, have some feedback or suggestions, please join us on the discord: https://discord.gg/4aCZ56W

notes.title: Local Co-op Update Backlog
notes.notes:
Local Co-op - March 2020
[previewyoutube=LN16QYUTQzA;full][/previewyoutube]
Added local co-op mode to the game where a friend can command a ship from your fleet on your computer while you are in VR. Control scheme based on games like Dreadnought or Fractured Space which is a 3rd person overhead camera with mouse pivot look. Keyboard commands for steering and number line for special abilities. The computer player will have the option to select from any ship in the fleet. The ship will ignore any commands given in VR if it is controlled by the PC player and there is a marking indicating so. Preview footage here: YouTube Video Preview

notes.title: Inventory Update
notes.notes: New update with an overhaul of the ship equipment system. We now have an inventory and hardpoint system per ship that will allow full customization of each vessel. New items can be discovered during missions and unlocked and purchased in a new equipment tab within the campaign home base menu.
